tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi ngag 'don byin rlabs dpal 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs

so// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi ngag 'don byin rlabs dpal 'bar zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// lam 'dir mos pa dag gis lnga ldan myong khrid thob nas chag med 'don sgom zung 'brel bya ba ni/ stan bde bar bsam gtan gyi chos bdun dang ldan pas rang rgyud dang nges par 'dre nges shes par ngag nas/ kye ma/ dal 'byor 'di 'dra shin tu rnyed dka' zhing*// 'jig par sla ba'i lus 'di thob pa'i tshe// don med rnam g.yeng dbang du ma song bar// bde 'bras thar pa bsgrub la gzhol bar bya// 'dus byas mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te// 'gro kun skyes nas 'chi ba nyid las gzhan// nam 'chi nges med rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra// myur du snying po'i don la brtson re ran// dge bas bde ba 'thob cing gcig shos kyis// sdug bsngal 'bras smin rgyu las 'byung ba'i phyir// bslu med rgyu 'bras gshis sam babs kyi chos// blang dor gnas la deng nas 'bad par bgyi// ngan song gsum dang mngon mtho'i go 'phang la'ang*// skad cig tsam gyi bde ba yod min zhing*// srid par 'phyan pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa de// dor nas zhi ba'i lam mchog bsgrub par bya// gnas khang 'og min zhing dang dbyer med pa'i// rang mdun seng chen pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// dbus su drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang gi tshul// sngo bsangs phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung 'gying tshul bzhugs// dar dang rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes// brgyud pa'i bshes gnyen rnams dang thabs cig bzhugs// mdun du yi dam 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /yab yum snang stong zung 'jug snyoms 'jug tshul| |g.yas su dus gsum sangs rgyas mtshan dper ldan// bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong dang lhan cig bzhugs// rgyab tu shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i yum// drang nges theg gsum chos kyi nga ro sgrog

/g.yon du brtse ldan byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// theg gsum dge 'dun rnams kyis yongs su bskor// khri yi mtshams kun dam pa chos skyong ba'i// srung ma dam can sprin 'khrigs lta bur bsam// sangs rgyas chos tshogs yi dam chos skyong bcas// skyabs mchog rnams la bdag sogs 'gro ba kun// srid pa'i 'jig tshogs nyam nga las skyob phyir| |byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi// gsum dang*/ 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// myur du bla med thob par bdag dga' bas// de'i phyir deng nas byang chub ma thob bar// nges pa'i don mchog lam la 'jug par bya// gsum dang*/ skyabs yul rang la bstim/ spyi bor pad dkar zla steng hūm̐ yig las// rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ mtshan 'od 'phros pas// 'gro drug sgrib sbyangs rgyal mchod tshur 'dus pa// sa bon la thim yongs su gyur pa las// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdor sems he ru kaḥ /rdo rje dril bcas gsang yum dmar mor 'khyud/ */dga' ma gri gug thod khrag dang bcas rol// brkyang bskum 'gying ba'i tshul gyis rin chen dang*// rus pa'i rgyan 'chang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// yab kyi thugs kar zla steng rdo rje yi// lte bar hūm̐ mthing yig brgyas bskor ba las// 'od 'phros 'gro ba'i sgrib pa kun sbyangs nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la rab bkod cing*// 'od zer de dag tshur 'dus sngags phreng dang*// sa bon la thim de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun// yab yum mkha' gsang las thon bdag nyid kyi// tshangs bug nas zhugs sdig sgrib nyes ltung tshogs// 'og sgor dud khu ltar bab bdud rtsi'i rgyun// mas brtan rang lus shel ltar dag par gyur// he ru ka'i yig brgya ci mang bzlas shing mthar/ bdag sogs rmongs pas dam las 'gal gyur par// mgon pos skyobs shig gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin// 'gro ba'i gtso bo bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig

/de skad gsol bas rdor sems dgyes tshul gyis// khyod kyi sdig sgrib dag go zhes gsungs te// bdag la thim pas sgrib pa byang bar bsam/ rang mdun seng chen pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*/ zhes pa nas/ srung ma rgya mtsho sprin 'khrigs lta bur bsam/ zhes sngar bzhin gsal btab la/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs sogs maṇ+ḍal dang*| rang gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa 'bul/ 'dod gsol ni/ bdag lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa bar bcas// rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la deng 'bul gyi// bzhes nas dam pa rnams kyis gang rtogs pa'i// nges pa'i don mchog bdag gis rtogs par shog /rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal mdun gyi mkhar/ seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du// ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// rnam pa bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang gi sku// sngo bsangs yum bcas sgeg cing mtshan dpes brgyan// rdo rje dril bu bsnol thabs yum la 'khyud// rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs de yi pang*// gsang yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma// rdor dril 'dzin pas yab 'khyud pad skyil gyis// yab la 'khril zhing mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar// yab yum rin chen rus rgyan dar dpyangs 'phyang*// sku la zhing khams kun rdzogs chu zla ltar// snang la rang bzhin ma grub 'od nang bzhugs// de la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dang*| |mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis bskor gnas gsum du// yi ge gsum ldan de las 'od 'phros pas// phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam chos srung bcas// spyan drangs rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku la bstim| |sangs rgyas kun 'dus rang bzhin bla mar gsal// mchod pa 'bul zhing rigs kun mas gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i dpral mgrin thugs ka lte ba las// dkar dmar mthing ser 'od 'phros bdag nyid kyi// gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob// lus ngag yid gsum shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs// bskyed rdzogs phyag chen bden gnyis bsgom la dbang*// sku bzhi 'grub byas 'khor tshogs gtso bor bsdus// gtso bo 'od zhu bdag gi smin mtshams thim// bdag dang bla ma ngo bo dbyer med blta// zhes thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro brgyad song nas/

khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la/ dang po byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ mkha' mnyam 'gro 'di bskal pa thog med nas// da lta'i bar du bdag gi mar gyur cing*// de bas 'tshe zhing sdang ba kun spangs nas// drin can ma rnams byams pas bskyang bar rigs// ma rnams bde ba 'dod kyang las ngan gyi// 'bras bus ngan song gsum du rab mnar zhing*// mi bzod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa dag /kun nas mi bzod snying rje'i gnas su gyur// de rnams bde ldan sdug bsngal tshogs bral zhing*// sdug bsngal med pa'i bde dang mi 'bral zhing*// btang snyoms mchog la gnas par bdag yid smon// de ltar sems la 'jug pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// 'gro rnams bde la 'god nus bdag cag la// med phyir dam pa'i go 'phang mchog bsgrubs nas// ma tshogs bde ba'i sa la 'god bya zhing*// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug byang chub sems// don dam blo 'das chos la 'bad par bya// gnyis pa yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ rang lus rdzogs rim rig pa hūm̐ zhu nā da'i rnam par mkhar gnas shing*// chos sku 'od gsal stong nyid ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur// dra ba bla bre me ri srung 'khor brjid 'bar dbus su nam mkha' dang*// rlung me chu sa ri rab steng du sna tshogs pad+ma rgya gram dbus// bh+rūṃ las rin chen sna tshogs las grub gzhal med khang chen 'od 'bar ba// mtshan nyid kun rdzogs phyi rol pad+ma rdo rje me ri dur khrod bcas// de'i dbus sna tshogs chu skyes lte bar nyi ma 'jigs dus gdan steng du// rta bdun bsil zer dkyil 'khor dbus su dbyangs gsal so sor dkar dmar dbus// rang rig nā da skad cig gis zhugs rdo rje hūm̐ bcas mthing 'od 'bar// 'od 'phros rgyal mchod 'gro ba'i don byas slar 'dus sa bon la thim zhing*// zla nyi sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i// rang nyid bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog gyur nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mdangs 'phrog cing*| |zhal gcig spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs shing skra mtshams rdo rje'i phreng sbrel zhing*// thod skam rin chen rtse phran rgyan can ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen bcings pa'i// rtse mor nor bu mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon du zla phyed spras// phyag gnyis rdor dril yum la 'khyud cing zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed kyi// mgo bo bltabs brdzis g.yas pa brkyangs nas dus mtshan nu ma'i bar mnan pa// stag sham grol zhing thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang bcas phyag rgya drug

/kun 'chang gar dgu'i nyams ldan pang du rdo rje rnal 'byor byu ru'i mdog /zhal gcig spyan gsum skra grol mtshams su thod pa skam po lngas bcings shing*// phyag g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing stob// g.yas pa sdigs mdzub rdo rje gri gug phyogs rnams kun la sdig pa'i tshul// g.yon zhabs brkyangs shing g.yas pa yab 'khril bde nyams bcu drug lang tsho can// rab mdzes gcer mo khrag la dgyes shing thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal dang*// phyag rgya lnga ldan yab yum gnyis ka mtshan dpes spras shing dar dpyangs 'phyang*// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid dang ldan thabs shes snyoms 'jug bde rol ba'i// mdun dang g.yon rgyab g.yas pa rnams su mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes ma// gzugs can ma rnams sngo ljang dmar ser zhal gcig spyan gsum rgod pa'i zhal// mche gtsigs skra grol thod skam dbu rgyan skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can// phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin// gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ldan zhing bde nyams sgeg cing gcer mo'i tshul// phyag rgya lnga ldan dbugs bral gdan la g.yas brkyang gar gyis rab tu 'gyings// mtshams bzhir zla steng bdud rtsi'i bum steng sha lngas gang ba'i thod pas mtshan// lha rnams dpral bar zla steng oṃ dkar mgrin par pad+ma āḥdamar po// snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ sngon yab kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar// mgo bor na ma hi ser dang ni spyi gtsug swā hā hu ljang gu// phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he nag mig gnyis huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser// yan lag kun la phaṭa haṃ ljang gu yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar// snying khar haṃ yoṃ kha dog sngo zhing kha ru hrīṃ moṃ dkar po la// mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ rab tu ser zhing spyi gtsug huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu can// yan lag kun la phaṭa phaṭa dud khas rab tu mtshan pa'i bskyed rim gsal// 'bar ba'i rgyas/

pheṃ pheṃ sgra dang snying ga'i hūm̐ 'od kyis// phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs dang*// dbang gi lhar bcas mdun du spyan drangs te// rig ma bcu drug gis mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥye shes pa dang dam tshig dbyer med gyur/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes pas gsol btab dbang lhas bdud rtsi yis/ bkang ba'i bum pa phyag tu thogs nas ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin mchog gyur nas// dbang lha rang thim chu lhag gyen 'khyil bas// gtso la mi bskyod yum la rnam snang dang*// mkha' 'gro ma bzhir rin 'byung dbu brgyan gyur// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar sbyar zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi sogs rig ma bcu drug dang*/ so so'i sngags mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod/ rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i| |khong pa rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// spyi bor haṃ dang mgrin par oṃ// dkar zhing snying gar hūm̐ sngon po// lte bar āḥdamar de nyid las// ye shes me 'bar 'khor lo gsum// so sor gnas pa'i yi ge rnams// bsregs shing haṃ las dkar cha bab// yi ge slar gsos bde drod 'bar// zhes bsam zhing dar cig rlung kha sbyor bzung*/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags thon pa// rdo rje'i lam las yum gyi ni// pad+mar zhugs te dbu mar brgyud// yum zhal nas thon rang nyid kyi// khar zhugs sa bon la thim pas// de ltar rgyun mi 'chad 'khor bsam// oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba ra swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ| ces ci nus bzlas shing*/ 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ so so'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mthar// sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od rnams las/ slar spros 'gro ba'i don byas pas// slar yang hūm̐ la thim par bsam// oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzla'o// bsdu rim bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis// srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas bsdus// gzhal yas la thim de nyid kyang*// mkha' 'gro bzhi dang de yum la// yum yab yab kyang thugs ka'i hūm̐// hūm̐ nyid zhabs kyu khog pa mgo// zla tshes nā da'i bar du bsdu// nā da'ang dmigs med 'od gsal ngang*// mnyam yangs ngang du la bzla'o// gsum pa bla ma bsgom pa ni/ slar yang rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i// snying khar chu skyes 'dab brgyad bzhad pa'i dbus// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi tshul// bai ḍūr+ya mdog rdor dril thugs kar bsnol// mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs rin chen rus pas brgyan// dar gyi chun 'phyang rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pas yongs su bskor// gtso 'khor kun kyang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i tshul// 'od zer nyi ma 'bum ltar brjid ldan bsam// de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa ci rigs bya'o// bla ma sku bzhir sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir tshig tshogs chung bar bsams nas so sor ma bshad kyang*/ ngo bo rang sems rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pas ngo bo nyid dang rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs su bshad pas sprul sku dang*/ de nyid nges pa lnga dang ldan pas longs sku/ thugs chos kyi sku yan lag bdun ldan du bzhugs pas sku bzhi chig dril du bstan pa yin no// de nas mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po dang bcas pa'i ngang nas/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru shrī badz+ra dhṛka ྄rat+na shrī bid+yā dha ra dharma kīrti karma bi dza ya se na hūm̐ ma ma ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes dar drag la yun ring du bzla'o// mthar/ brgyud pa'i tshogs zhing ma hā gu rur thim// de nyid 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa dang*| |rang sems dbyer med mnyam pa nyid gyur nas// khams gsum yongs sgrol rang rig rtogs par bsam// bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa ni/ rang sems gdod nas dag pa la// bar du ma rig rtog pas bsgribs// 'gyu ba ban bun na bun 'dra// cham gyis zhi bar gnas pa'i tshe// rang mdangs 'od gsal nyid kyang mthong*// de las lhag par mthong ba na// sems nyid spros pa dang bral ba// rnam med rnam pa kun gyi mchog /rgyu med rgyu yi gtso bo ste// dngos med dngos po kun ldan pa'i// bdag med bdag gi chos skur grol| |gang tshe 'gyu ba de nyid kyang*// ngo bo stong zhing rig mdangs gsal// zung 'jug sku ru shar grol nyid// dpe dang tshig gis ma bslad cing*// tha snyad lhad kyis ma bcos pa'i// rang gshis gnyug ma rang babs 'di// blo las 'das pa'i chos sku yin// gang gis stong pa nyid rtogs tshe// chos kun gshis babs rang lugs kyi// rten 'brel nyid du 'dir rtogs pas| |stong nyid rgyu 'bras kho nar ldang*// de'i tshe dgag bya kun bral zhing*// blang bar bya ba'ang gzhan med pas// dgag sgrub bral ba'i tshul khrims mchog /phyag rgya che dang gnad 'dir gcig /lnga pa bsngo ba ni/ de ltar bdag dang 'khor 'das 'gro kun gyis// bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge ba ji snyed dang*// kun mkhyen thob byed bde gshegs snying po sogs// dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed bgyis pa dang*// bgyid bstsal bgyi 'gyur dge tshogs mtha' dag kun// zhing dang bsam pa dngos por bcas pa yi// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis/

rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam par bsngo bgyi na// mchog gsum bla ma yi dam ḍā ki'i tshogs// chos srung chos dbyings rnam dag bden pa dang*// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i byin rlabs kyis| |bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro drug sems can rnams// rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces dang*/ bsngo smon gzhan yang skabs sbyar bgyi'o// smras pa/ rdo rje rgyal dang 'jig rten mgon po sogs| |rgyal ba yab sras kun gyi bzhed pa'i srol// tshig nyung don dril gnad la ma 'khrul ba'i// legs bshad byed po bstan pa'i rgyan min nam// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid dmigs 'don sgom zung du 'brel ba mdor bsdus pa byin rlabs dpal 'bar zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ rang re'i gra 'bangs mnga' ris bka' bcu pa rin chen lhun grub gtsos 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal pa'i sdes/ sa sbrul gro zhun zla ba'i dkar cha'i rdzogs pa gsum par chu klung chen po nā gardzu na'i sgra 'byin pa'i ngogs/ gtsug lag lugs gnyis kyi sgo 'phar cig car du 'byed pa dpal 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen por bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
